about: The kit's own page-link inputs (DEC-0123, decision D11 of the 0.51.0 brief): the WHATWG URL points the Python port reads by hand. Chosen by hand; their answers are the contract's, in page-link-extra-vectors.json, written by make_page_link_vectors.mjs. "@SK@" stands for a provider-key-shaped sample the generator builds from parts.
